title_ja: AI for Science・科学AIエージェント
title_en: AI for Science and scientific AI agents
summary_ja: 大規模学習・推論、科学AIエージェント、評価基盤をシステム要件へ接続する暫定ロードマップです。製品機能、ベンチマーク、公的な科学成果を分けて扱います。
summary_en: A provisional roadmap connecting large-scale training and inference, scientific AI agents, and evaluation infrastructure to system requirements. Product features, benchmarks, and scientific outcomes are treated separately.

tracks.name_ja: 分散学習・推論サービング
tracks.summary_ja: 並列化、メモリ、チェックポイント、待ち時間を扱います。
tracks.summary_en: Cover parallelism, memory, checkpoints, and latency.
tracks.current_state_ja: Megatron、DeepSpeed、vLLM、MLPerfの公開資料を基準にします。 今回の限定的な追補：ECMWFは入力解析世代の変更でGraphCast・Aurora・AIFS v1.1の精度変化を報告し、AIFS v2適応と外部モデルの同センター実時間運用停止を説明する。モデルの世界的廃止ではない。Anemoiの研究例は約100km・6時間入力から約30km・1時間出力へ反復samplerで変換するが、運用日・全系節約は未報告。AgentActionBenchは150論文（AI4Science30）、人手注釈15、GPT-4o-mini採点で行動過程と5段階を評価する。rubric総合点は完全再現論文の割合ではない。 PyTorch DCP2.14のstaging thread所有・cleanupをmemory条件と共に確認する。JSON checkpoint packageのlegacy resume条件は既存msgpack advisoryと別で、JS/TS Storeの設定依存cross-user認可問題を全Python packageの一般脆弱性へ拡張しない。package版・serializer・principal・expiry・checkpoint再開・Store認可を既存agent試験へ組み込み、site診断や再現済みとはしない。
tracks.current_state_en: Public Megatron, DeepSpeed, vLLM, and MLPerf materials form the baseline. Scoped additions in this batch: ECMWF reports quality changes for GraphCast, Aurora and AIFS v1.1 after initial-condition changes, adaptation of AIFS v2 and cessation of its external-model realtime runs, not worldwide model retirement. Anemoi research maps roughly 100km/six-hour inputs to 30km/hourly outputs through iterative sampling without reported deployment dates or end-to-end savings. AgentActionBench covers 150 papers (30 AI4Science), 15 human-annotated papers and GPT-4o-mini scoring of actions/five stages. Overall rubric scores are not fractions of completely reproduced papers. Add PyTorch DCP 2.14 staging-thread ownership/cleanup alongside memory conditions. Keep JSON-package legacy resume conditions distinct from the existing msgpack advisory; configuration-dependent JS/TS Store authorization does not establish a universal Python vulnerability. Add package versions, serializers, principals, expiry, checkpoint resumption and Store authorization to existing agent tests without site diagnosis or reproduction claims.
tracks.hpci_implications_ja: 学習と推論を同じピーク演算値だけで評価せず、通信、KV cache、データ経路を測定します。 非同期保存の境界と等資源推論比較を受入試験に加える。
tracks.hpci_implications_en: Do not evaluate training and inference by peak arithmetic alone; measure communication, KV cache, and data paths. Add asynchronous-save boundaries and equal-resource serving comparisons to acceptance tests.

tracks.name_ja: 科学タスクとエージェント評価
tracks.summary_ja: 正答、再現性、費用、時間、ツール利用を扱います。
tracks.summary_en: Cover correctness, reproducibility, cost, time, and tool use.

tracks.current_state_en: ScienceAgentBench and Jalapeno public results cover different evaluation scopes. Scoped additions in this batch: ECMWF reports quality changes for GraphCast, Aurora and AIFS v1.1 after initial-condition changes, adaptation of AIFS v2 and cessation of its external-model realtime runs, not worldwide model retirement. Anemoi research maps roughly 100km/six-hour inputs to 30km/hourly outputs through iterative sampling without reported deployment dates or end-to-end savings. AgentActionBench covers 150 papers (30 AI4Science), 15 human-annotated papers and GPT-4o-mini scoring of actions/five stages. Overall rubric scores are not fractions of completely reproduced papers. Add PyTorch DCP 2.14 staging-thread ownership/cleanup alongside memory conditions. Keep JSON-package legacy resume conditions distinct from the existing msgpack advisory; configuration-dependent JS/TS Store authorization does not establish a universal Python vulnerability. Add package versions, serializers, principals, expiry, checkpoint resumption and Store authorization to existing agent tests without site diagnosis or reproduction claims.
tracks.hpci_implications_ja: HPCIで実行可能な科学タスク群と監査可能な実行記録が必要です。 永続状態の整合性と再開時の復元型の制約も検証する。
tracks.hpci_implications_en: HPCI needs executable scientific task suites and auditable run records. Also qualify persistent-state integrity and type restrictions during resume.

milestones.label_ja: 分散学習・推論機能を確認
milestones.detail_ja: 公開機能の確認であり、候補HPCI構成上の性能測定ではありません。
milestones.detail_en: This checks public capabilities and is not a performance measurement on candidate HPCI systems.

milestones.label_ja: 共通受入試験の時期は未確定
milestones.detail_ja: 固定モデル、入力、同時実行数、精度、電力での比較日程はありません。 提案試験ではstaging完了、保存中のCPU・固定メモリ、再開の正しさを測り、推論は同一総GPU数の併置対照、実到着分布、p95/p99、ノード全体エネルギーを含める。 追補条件：入力解析世代の変化・model適応の費用とDCP staging thread所有/cleanupを確認する。研究samplerの解像度変換を実運用・全系節約に一般化しない。実行日は引き続き未設定。
milestones.detail_en: No schedule exists for comparison with pinned models, inputs, concurrency, accuracy, and power. Proposed tests measure staging completion, CPU/pinned-memory load during saves and restart correctness; inference comparisons include equal-total-GPU colocation, real arrival distributions, p95/p99 and whole-node energy. Additional criteria: qualify initial-condition generation changes/model-adaptation costs and DCP staging-thread ownership/cleanup. Research sampler resolution conversion is not operational deployment or whole-system savings. No execution date is set.

A provisional plan to pilot public tasks measuring correctness, reproducibility, time, cost, and tool permissions. Additional proposed criteria separate execution from scientific validation and consider fixed budgets, null models, external-data validation, inconclusive outcomes and resource records for CPU analysis, LLM inference, queues and retries. The existing Q2 2027 date is an OpenFS proposal, not a paper or vendor delivery commitment. Add checkpoint write boundaries, effective serializer configuration, rejection of unapproved types and legitimate-resume compatibility to the provisional test conditions. Additional criteria: distinguish action/rubric scores from complete scientific-reproduction fractions; test package-specific JSON/msgpack, legacy resume and configuration-dependent JS/TS Store authorization. Infer no universal Python vulnerability or site diagnosis. Coding agents reference existing PORT-AUTO scope/denominator/human-adjudication evidence without a duplicate lane.
milestones.label_ja: 科学タスク群の暫定実証点
milestones.detail_ja: 正答、再実行性、時間、費用、ツール権限を測る公開タスク群を試す暫定計画です。 追加の暫定評価条件として、実行と科学的検証を別計測し、固定予算、帰無モデル、外部データ検証、未確定判定、CPU解析・LLM推論・待機・再試行の資源記録を検討します。既存の2027年Q2はOpenFS案であり、論文やベンダーの提供約束ではありません。 暫定試験条件にcheckpointの書込境界、実効serializer設定、不許可型の拒否と正常再開の両立を加える。 追補条件：行動/rubric点と完全科学再現割合を分け、package別JSON/msgpack・legacy resume・JS/TS Storeの設定依存認可を試験する。一般Python脆弱性やsite診断へ拡張しない。移植agentは既存PORT-AUTOのscope/分母・人判定を参照し新laneを作らない。

milestones.label_en: Evaluation by independent models is undated

caveat_ja: 単一のAIモデル・単一エージェントによる暫定調査です。独立したAIモデルによるConsensus Gateは未完了です。公表資料の確認時点、公開目標、OpenFSの暫定計画を区別し、未公表の時期・費用・性能は推測していません。
caveat_en: Provisional research by one model and one agent; Consensus review by independent models is incomplete. Documentation checks, published targets, and provisional OpenFS plans are separated, and unpublished timing, cost, and performance are not inferred.
